explication: ChurchCRM is a self-hosted church relationship-management application. Its principal workflow is authenticated staff managing people and families, organizing them into groups, recording events and attendance, tracking giving, and producing reports. Public registration, kiosk check-in, search, administration, plugins, backups, upgrades, and MailChimp integration are additional branches. The graph reflects the documented product flow and sampled route, service, authentication, plugin, kiosk, and reporting files; several unsampled route-to-service calls are represented only where the tree and names provide clear support.
